create_pixel_dist_matrix: create a pixel distance matrix for a given grid size using squared Euclidean distances
sample_fg_pixels_randperm: sample foreground pixel indices from a binary mask using random permutation
sample_fg_pixels_multinomial: sample foreground pixel indices from a binary mask using multinomial sampling
build_pix_to_shape_cycle_loss: build a PixToShapeCycleLoss module from a Detectron2 config node for pixel-vertex cycle loss
run_pix_to_shape_cycle_loss_forward: run the forward pass of PixToShapeCycleLoss with proposals, predictor outputs, annotations, and an embedder
